operations.rationale: Removing duplicate records ensures data integrity and prevents the inflation of sales and profit metrics.
Median imputation is chosen over mean because the sales distribution is highly skewed (1.48), making the median a more robust measure of central tendency.
Capping outliers using the IQR method minimizes the influence of extreme sales values on aggregate statistics without losing the data points entirely.
Profit data contains extreme values on both ends; capping ensures that profitability analysis is not skewed by anomalous transactions.
Restricting discount values to the IQR range prevents extreme promotional values from disproportionately affecting margin calculations.
Explicitly casting to datetime ensures the column is correctly typed for time-series analysis and date-based filtering.
